about: What tools/mantle_check.py (G2, Docs/Design/84 §9.6, §11, §14.4, §17.3) holds a mantle to, beside truth.json and tools/dialect_check.py's lexicon. tiers: each tier's size (§9.3's lines, about: reported, a gate only with --strict, from Phase 11) and its minimum (what a `ready` mantle must have: its symbols, its lines (line, rule, scene and story items), the moves it must answer itself (a kind of the move counts: react.news.new is a react.news), its window lines and stories, and the sections a spare needs for pups). allow: capitalised words a mantle may say outside a sentence's start beside the realm's places (tools/dialect_allow.json's places and legend, Data/Economy/communities.json): the realm's towns, Houses, weekdays, seasons' feasts, the two deities. forbidden: words never in world text (the project's rules), each with why. pronouns: he, she, him, her, his and hers are never said in a sentence that names a person by a slot (they come from the person's sex: #other.they#, #x.their#). habits: at most this share of a mantle's alternatives say one of its habits (oath!, saying!: §14.4's saturation). density: the share of a non-plain mantle's alternatives that should carry a dialect marker (§10.1; a warning, a gate with --strict).

forbidden.why: never the word dog in world text (wolves; pups for the young)
the deities are the Bright One and the Dark One, never gods
characters are male or female only
